build_s2t_transformer_model: build a speech-to-text transformer model with Conv1dSubsampler encoder and TransformerDecoder for ASR tasks
create_conv1d_subsampler: create a Conv1dSubsampler module that downsamples audio features using stacked 1D convolutions with GLU activation
build_s2t_transformer_encoder: build an S2TTransformerEncoder that combines a convolutional subsampler with Transformer encoder layers for speech input
configure_s2t_architecture: configure s2t_transformer architecture variants (s/m/l) with preset encoder dimensions, attention heads, and dropout rates
run_s2t_transformer_forward: run the S2TTransformerModel forward pass with source tokens, lengths, and previous output tokens for inference
